grand-tour-of-switzerland-bellinzona-mon.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland: Bellinzona to Montreux
grand-tour-of-switzerland-bellinzona-mon.slogan: Bellinzona to Montreux, over 2429 m · one way, about 546 km back to the start

sections.advice: Bellinzona → Lugano is 27 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Lugano → Andermatt is 94 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
Andermatt → Furka Pass climbs about 2429 m in 18 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Furka Pass → Tasch for Zermatt drops about 2429 m over 94 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Tasch for Zermatt → Montreux is 97 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: For 45 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Furka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it. The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2429 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Simplon Pass Road
scenicChapters.narrative: 155 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it — this is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

grand-tour-of-switzerland-bellinzona-mon.story: 546 km from Bellinzona to Montreux, about 7 h 47 of riding. On the way it passes Lugano, Andermatt, Furka Pass and Tasch for Zermatt. The highest point is about 2,650 m. Furka Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

scenicChapters.title: Passo di Croce Domini
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 70 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
